tool.name: datav-query-dataset
tool.description:
Execute a dataset query and return tabular results.
The dataset must be a pre-registered SQL dataset (dsType=sql). The params object supplies values for ${paramName} placeholders in the dataset's SQL text; values are bound as parameterized SQL variables (NOT concatenated), so SQL injection is prevented by construction.
Returns JSON with: - columns: array of column names (in result order) - rows: array of row objects (each row is column-name -> value)
Safety constraints: - Only pre-registered datasets can be queried; LLM cannot generate arbitrary SQL. - maxRows caps the result size (OOM protection, enforced via dataset-level row ranging). The schemaJson maximum is a default-snapshot hint only; the server clamps maxRows to [1, nop.datav.chatbi.max-rows] at runtime regardless of what the caller sends.
If the dataset does not exist or is not a SQL dataset, returns a JSON error object.
